samples.claim: map_offset starts mid=offset+last_diff and right=offset+deletion count cast to u32. Each loop counts deleted offsets in 0..mid+1 and compares mid with offset+deleted_count. Equality with an undeleted mid stores last_diff=mid-offset and returns. Less asserts left!=mid+1, advances left=mid+1, then bisects [left,right]; greater or equality at a deleted mid moves right=mid and bisects. The comment explains leftward search for an overshooting guess. left persists across calls and is not reset on success; input monotonicity is not checked. Additions, subtraction, mid+1 and cardinality cast have no checked-error path, so near-u32-limit inputs can overflow under checked arithmetic or wrap otherwise. No validation rejects ordinals past actual fragment rows because that length is absent. With Set, every range-cardinality step scans 0..mid+1, a potentially large cost unrelated to set cardinality.
samples.review_note: Matches binary-search state/arithmetic and absent input checks; supplementary deletion63-69 confirms Set range scanning.

samples.claim: From<object_store::Error> converts direct NotFound path to Lance NotFound and intentionally drops its original source; every other store error is boxed as IO. samples.claim: pub explain_fields_difference constructs HashSets of actual/expected names, prefixes paths with raw dot concatenation, computes unexpected and disallowed missing names and emits one combined message if needed. allow_subschema suppresses all missing reports; allow_missing_if_nullable suppresses missing nullable fields by finding the first expected name match. HashSet iteration means ordering of multiple missing/unexpected names is not explicitly stable. These paths are diagnostic text, not escaped field expressions.
samples.review_note: Matches sets, raw dotted diagnostics and missing-field policy precedence.

samples.claim: test_compare constructs dictionary values and metadata/ID differences. Default comparison ignores dictionary, metadata and field IDs; enabling each corresponding option makes the difference visible. It explicitly assigns an ID through set_id for the ID case. This configurable policy differs from derived PartialEq, not from a mutation of the underlying field representation.
samples.review_note: Matches default and enabled comparison cases plus explicit set_id.

Otherwise it parses, falls back on any error to treating the whole input as one literal segment, doubles backticks and quotes every segment. It is deliberately non-fallible; malformed path text is escaped rather than rejected, and empty input becomes a quoted empty segment. Tests module imports Arrow aliases, HashMap/Arc and the module API.

samples.claim: Hasher::finish xors state with state>>32 to spread high bits down. Byte write performs wrapping FNV-1a multiplication by 0x0000_0100_0000_01b3. write_u32/write_u64 overwrite state with value times wrapping golden-ratio constant 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15; write_usize casts and delegates. IntMap<K,V> aliases HashMap with BuildHasherDefault<IntHasher>; generic composite keys remain equality-correct but may collide heavily. HashMap iteration is not a source ordering contract.
samples.review_note: Matches xor fold, FNV multiplier, overwrite integer hashes and generic map alias.

samples.claim: committed_version=3 is the commit that made the overlay effective, not its read version. It is stamped at commit and restamped on retry. An index built at dataset_version >= committed_version incorporates the overlay; an older index must exclude affected cells for those fields and reevaluate current values. Greater committed_version wins across overlays; equal versions use later DataFragment.overlays position. Incorrect stamping or sorting changes query results.
samples.evidence:
222 |   /* The dataset version at which this overlay became effective: the version of
223 |    * the commit that introduced it, NOT the version it was read from. It is
224 |    * stamped at commit time and re-stamped if the commit is retried, in the same
225 |    * way as the created-at / last-updated-at version sequences.
226 |    *
227 |    * This drives two orderings:
228 |    *  * Versus index builds: an index whose `dataset_version` >= this value
229 |    *    already incorporates this overlay. Otherwise the overlay's covered cells
230 |    *    are excluded from index results for the affected fields and re-evaluated
231 |    *    against their current values (see the Data Overlay Files specification).
232 |    *  * Versus other overlays: when two overlays cover the same (offset, field),
233 |    *    the one with the higher `committed_version` wins. Overlays that share a
234 |    *    `committed_version` are ordered by their position in
235 |    *    `DataFragment.overlays`, where a later entry is newer and wins.
236 |    */
237 |   uint64 committed_version = 3;
238 | }
239 |
samples.review_note: Matches commit stamping, retry restamping, index visibility and overlay precedence.

samples.claim: PQ records num_bits=1, num_sub_vectors=2, dimension=3, repeated float codebook=4, and Tensor codebook_tensor=5. Both codebook descriptions require dimension times 2^num_bits scalar values. This is metadata, not the sub-vector layout or distance implementation; no legal-bit-range validation appears.

samples.claim: unloaded_mut replaces logical_type, children and the entire metadata map with canonical v2 descriptor fields when is_blob_v2; otherwise uses the legacy descriptor for any blob; non-blobs remain unchanged. Name/id/parent_id/nullable, encoding, dictionary and position members are preserved. The cloned synthetic children carry unassigned IDs, not automatically reparented values. Replacing the metadata map discards unrelated metadata, including the extension name; structural recognition keeps a v2 descriptor recognizable.
samples.review_note: Matches selective mutation; supplementary descriptor constants129-150, field import1204-1221/1294-1315 and structural predicate623-634 confirm metadata/IDs.

samples.claim: For an invalid/NULL position return Ok(None) before reading or validating the underlying label, so arbitrary null payload values are allowed. Otherwise validate that label, compute count_before(block,label)+rank_label_prefix(values,validity,pos,label) using ordinary u32 addition, and return (label,offset). There is no destination-fragment-ID lookup, comparison with final destination totals, or validation that every supplied prefix label matches the stored counts.

Unrepresentable custom stop words/document extraction and external jieba/lindera dictionaries are rejected by the contract. Empty text behavior is not resolved by this paragraph alone.

samples.claim: Private SEED=0 and generic hash_as_bytes feed AsBytes bytes directly to XxHash64::oneshot. Seed/hash algorithm must agree for insertion, query and interpretation of serialized filters.
